name: The Libertines

whyMatters.en: London garage-punk four whose Up the Bracket (2002, Mick Jones) and dual-vocal Doherty–Barât partnership mapped post-Strokes UK indie chaos onto Rough Trade 45s.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦车库朋克四人组：Up the Bracket（2002，Mick Jones）与 Doherty–Barât 双人声搭档，把后 Strokes 英国 indie 混乱写进 Rough Trade 45。

essentialTracks.title: Don't Look Back into the Sun

lyricQuotes: There are fewer more distressing sights than that / Of an Englishman in a baseball cap
Don't look back into the sun

shortBio.en: Barât / Doherty garage-punk; Mick Jones production, Can't Stand Me Now the dual-vocal split document.
shortBio.zh: Barât / Doherty 车库朋克；Mick Jones 制作，Can't Stand Me Now 是双人声分裂文献。

body.en:
Formed 1997 in London. Early Rough Trade releases and Mick Jones’s production on Up the Bracket (2002) put raw dual vocals, loose drums, and music-hall lyric references on the post-Strokes UK map.

The Libertines (2004) delivered Can't Stand Me Now—call-response vocals charting the Doherty–Barât fracture. Tabloid coverage is public record; musically they export urgency and song craft over polish.
body.zh:
1997 年于伦敦组建。早期 Rough Trade 发行与 Mick Jones 在 Up the Bracket（2002）的制作，把毛糙双人声、松鼓组与音乐厅式歌词指涉放上后 Strokes 英国地图。

The Libertines（2004）交出 Can't Stand Me Now——呼叫—回应人声记录 Doherty–Barât 分裂。小报报道属公开记录；音乐上输出紧迫感与歌曲工艺，而非抛光。

title.zh: The Strokes 之后的车库紧迫感

body.en:
Up the Bracket keeps Clash-era speed with 2000s indie slack—What a Waster’s BBC controversy is chart/media fact. Dual frontmen trade lines without harmonized polish.

Song craft under chaos: Time for Heroes, Don't Look Back into the Sun as tight 45s.
body.zh:
Up the Bracket 保留 Clash 时代速度配 2000 年代 indie 松弛——What a Waster 的 BBC 争议是榜单/媒体事实。双主唱交换句子，无和谐抛光。

混乱下的歌曲工艺：Time for Heroes、Don't Look Back into the Sun 作为紧致 45。

title.zh: 经典四人与 Doherty 缺席

body.en:
Peak unit: Barât and Doherty guitars/vocals, Hassall bass, Powell drums. Doherty’s absences and 2004 split interrupt the run; reunions restore the four-piece for festivals.

Mick Jones production credit marks the Clash lineage on tape.
body.zh:
峰值单元：Barât 与 Doherty 吉他/人声、Hassall 贝斯、Powell 鼓。Doherty 缺席与 2004 分裂打断进程；重聚在音乐节恢复四人组。

Mick Jones 制作署名标记 Clash 血统在磁带里。

title.en: London indie chaos into Arctic Monkeys
title.zh: 伦敦 indie 混乱进入 Arctic Monkeys

body.en:
The Libertines export loose dual-vocal garage and lyric locality that Arctic Monkeys and Franz Ferdinand inherit in the 2000s UK revival wave.

Clash production DNA plus Strokes timing—document, not stadium polish.
body.zh:
The Libertines 输出松双人声车库与歌词地方法，Arctic Monkeys 与 Franz Ferdinand 在 2000 年代英国复兴波继承。

Clash 制作 DNA 加 Strokes 时机——文献，非体育场抛光。
